scope: midi-config-v4 partial requirement clauses only (see spec.md)
fixture_origin: Independently authored minimal ASCII inputs and MIDI byte sequences; no shipped file copied
oracle_status: Static-derived and extracted-execution expectations, labeled per case; neither reference nor candidate executed

representation.assignment: section, control, target, message_type, number, channel; map_mode for continuous controls; button_kind for buttons; neither for pads
representation.device_parameter_banks: null when no Encoder assignment is enabled, else 1 or 2
representation.note: project comparison representation, not an API of the original application or a required design
representation.stimulus: value cases only: takeover (none, pick-up, value-scaling, or any = every takeover choice); parameter (target, kind, stepped, min, max, initial_value, a binary32 number); messages (three-byte Control Change messages in hexadecimal, applied in order)
representation.values: value cases only: expected.values, the target parameter value after each message rounded to nine decimals (exact results for static-derived cases, extracted-execution results otherwise), compared within tau = max(1e-6, 2^-22 * max(|min|, |max|)) absolute; tau is 1e-6 for cases 110 to 127
